 The New Orleans Pelicans are expected to start the season completely healthy.
 Guard Dejounte Murray , who missed the previous three preseason games with a toe injury, practiced fully Monday morning.
 Murray said after practice that he expects to play at 7 p.m. Wednesday when the Pelicans host the Indiana Pacers in the season opener.
 “I’m good,” he said. “I’m great. Happy to be on the floor.”
 Murray said the injury happened on the second day of training camp when his toe got stepped on.
 “Just was being cautious of it,” Murray said about his absences. “It was really fat. And purple. It was really just getting the swelling down. That was it. I feel great. It’s not swollen (now). I’m able to run, jump, participate.”
 Murray scored six points to go with six assists and four rebounds in his only preseason game, the opener against the Oklahoma City Thunder.
 Murray is entering his third season with the Pelicans. He is averaging 17.2 points and 7.0 assists since arriving in New Orleans. 
 Final roster
 The Pelicans on Monday announced their roster for opening night.
 The Pelicans now have 15 players on standard contracts, plus three players on a two-way contract.
 The 15 players on a standard contract are Herb Jones , Trey Murphy , Murray, Zion Williamson , Jeremiah Fears , Yves Missi , Karlo Matkovic , Bennedict Mathurin , Jordan Poole , Derik Queen , Saddiq Bey , DeAndre Jordan , AJ Johnson , Bryce McGowens and Trendon Watford .
 Jaron Pierre , Malika Dia and Julian Reese are on two-way contracts and will split time between the Pelicans and the Laketown Squadron, the G League affiliate in Kenner.
 Familiar foe
 Mathurin will face his former team when the Pacers come to town Wednesday.
 Mathurin, who the Pelicans signed to a two-year deal in late August, spent his first 3½ seasons with the Pacers. The Pacers traded him to the Los Angeles Clippers in February.
 Mathurin isn’t making a big deal out of playing the team that drafted him with the No. 6 overall pick in 2022.
 “It’s just another game for me, to be honest,” he said.
 The game will feature the return for Pacers point guard Tyrese Haliburton , who tore his Achilles in Game 7 of the NBA Finals in 2025.
 “It’s great,” Mathurin said. “God bless that he’s healthy. He’s been rehabbing for a long time. I’m very blessed, and it’s great for the game of basketball that he’s back on the court.”
 Opening night
 To recognize the 25th year of the Pelicans being in New Orleans, the first 6,000 fans at the Smoothie King Center on Wednesday will receive a commemorative hat. The halftime performer will be Red Panda , who will ride her unicycle while flipping bowls onto her head.
